summary.text: Pat McGeehan is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates who has represented District 1 since 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Air Force Academy graduate and former Air Force officer, he is president of Mountain State Packaging Incorporated.

paragraphs.text: Pat McGeehan graduated from Oak Glen High School in New Cumberland and earned a B.S. in general engineering from the United States Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs, attending from 1999 to 2003.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1998 to 2006, including as an intelligence officer and captain from 2003 to 2006.
McGeehan has been president of Mountain State Packaging Incorporated in Newell, West Virginia, since 2006 and president of Panhandle Industries in Weirton since 2007.
He previously served in the House of Delegates in District 1 from 2008 to 2010, before returning to the seat in 2014.
